description: This file defines a custom exception class 'EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException' used in the eShopOnWeb application to handle cases where a checkout is attempted with an empty basket.

classes.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating that an attempt to checkout with an empty basket was made.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message and an inner exception for chaining.
